description.value: Guilt & Co is an underground live music pub in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood, operating since 2010 with two non-ticketed live shows every night, seven days a week. The venue is first-come-first-served, emphasising spontaneous discovery of new artists, and charges a music fee at the door that goes entirely to performers or to Downtown Eastside charities on GroundUp Thursdays. Food is made in-house from fresh, ethically sourced ingredients, and the cocktail program draws on local distilleries.
